items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Bigle was Milton Berle's mouthpiece... Johnny Bigle used to tell them all that stuff.

ctx.x: Milton Berle used to come to the theater, as I say, every day to listen to Alan Drew. And instead of Alan Drew cleaning up his stuff, like Milton did, becoming the greatest -- Johnny Bigle was Milton Berle's mouthpiece.
